units.source_text: 名人一埋头于这盘棋，就完全忘却自己的存在，一任工作人员的安排，不再像往常那样任性了。

en.t: Once the Master buried himself in this game, he completely forgot his own existence, left everything to the staff's arrangements, and was no longer as willful as usual.

units.source_text: 就是在名人患病，发生“以后怎么办”的纠纷之时，他虽是关键的当事人，也总是心不在焉，好像旁人的事似的。

en.t: Even when the Master fell ill and a dispute arose over what should be done afterward, although he was the central person concerned, he was always absentminded, as if it were someone else's affair.
